title: Online Features, Network Services, and NETR.ovl Formally Classified Out of Scope

ps2_overlay_dropped.action: Removed from dynamic overlay manifest (recomp/overlays/OVERLAY-MAP-MANIFEST.json); never loaded on accepted route

ps2_main_elf_online_functions.action: Classified as out-of-scope-stubbed; routed to retail offline path

xbox_donor_online_functions.action: Classified as out-of-scope-stubbed; Xbox Live thunks and APIs excluded from donor recovery

implementation_rules: Route online startup strictly through the game's retail offline path (matching physical PS2 console with no network adapter attached).
Never fake success: synthetic network success or silent no-ops are strictly forbidden by the native port contract.
Any direct invocation that cannot function offline fails by name (e.g. online_unavailable / source_refused).
UI menus for network/online match original PS2-without-network behavior (disabled or absent).
Acceptance checkers skip online scenarios only when this decision file is authenticated.

deviations.rationale: Caller 0x00122900 discards return value of 0x003432d0; returning true with StartupError::none signals uninterrupted continuation along retail offline path.

Retail PS2 offline failure in 0x0033ecf0 resets internal buffers in ShutdownPartial (0x00343e80) but leaves the 84-byte 'Online' heap object allocated and -21272(gp) non-NULL. Native port leaves the pointer strictly NULL and omits the 84-byte dangling allocation. Disassembly proves zero offline gameplay functions read -21272(gp), offline update handlers explicitly null-guard the pointer, and allocation-profile tests do not measure general heap objects.

In retail SLUS_214.10, selecting 'Go Online' on hardware without a network adapter immediately triggers the adapter-less hardware preemption path presenting error string 0x00639C80 ('No network adaptor (Ethernet/modem) (for PlayStation2) detected. You will not be able to access the online features of this title.'), returning to the main menu; the authentication-failure string at 0x005E6320 ('Could not authenticate user ID and Password. Please check your network configuration and try again.') is only reached if a network adapter is attached and configuration authentication fails. In native PC recompilation, trigger_retail_go_online_modal and get_retail_online_modal_string are unwired component helpers (extracting authentic string 0x005E6320 for offline tests), not completed missing-adapter fallbacks in the live menu loop. The intended native response when main menu dispatch is ported is to display an authentic unavailable-online modal dialog based on 0x00639C80 ('No network adaptor detected / Online features unavailable in offline native recompilation') and cleanly return to the main menu without loading NETR.ovl or allocating sockets.
